title: linaria verticillata subsp. anticaria
intro: Linaria verticillata subsp. anticaria, commonly known as Antirrhinum anticaria or Antirrhinum anticarium, is a flowering plant species in the family Plantaginaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Linaria verticillata subsp. anticaria include wound healing, anti-oxidant activity, and protection against liver damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
